_what: The bytes site-factory/figma-draw.js emits, committed so a change to the generator arrives as a reviewable diff rather than a silently passing test.
_why_bytes_not_a_digest: A digest mismatch names no change. The script writes to the live Figma file; a reviewer needs to see what a redraw would do before it does it.
_inputs_are_diagnostics: These digests are NOT asserted. They exist so a failure can say whether an input moved (ordinary) or only the emitter did (needs eyes).
